Rule: There are two 4-colored objects. One 7-group has 4-cells directly below it (the moving piece); the other 7-group marks the attachment point. Shift the moving piece so that the 4-cell directly below its 7 lands on the target 7, overlay it on the fixed object, remove all 7s, and crop to the union bounding box.

```json
[[4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4],[4,1,4,1,4,4,4,4,4,1],[4,1,4,1,4,4,4,4,4,1],[4,1,4,1,4,4,4,4,4,1],[1,1,1,1,1,4,4,4,1,1]]
```

Rule: Treat every 4-connected same-color region (excluding the dominant background color) as one object. Output a vertical bar for each object, ordered top-to-bottom then left-to-right; each bar contains the object's color repeated once per pixel of that object.

```json
[[1],[1],[1],[1],[1],[3],[3],[3],[8],[8],[8],[8],[8],[8],[4],[4],[4],[4],[4],[4],[3],[3],[1],[1],[1]]
```

Rule: Each grid has one 9×9 object (a 3×3 lattice of 3×3 blocks with an empty 3×3 center hole) on the background color. The output embeds a 5×5 lattice of 3×3 blocks: the object's 8 ring blocks stay in place, the hole is filled by the inward continuation of the surrounding ring (fill cell (i,j) = object cell (2+2i, 2+2j), fill center = object cell (2,3)), and every even lattice position (p,q) outside the object receives the 180°-rotation of object block (p/2, q/2) while odd outer positions stay background. The resulting 15×15 pattern is pasted 3 cells up-left of the object's top-left corner; grid size and background elsewhere are unchanged (verified block-by-block on all three training pairs).

```json
[[8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8],[8,4,4,7,8,8,8,7,1,7,8,8,8,7,4,4,8],[8,4,7,7,8,8,8,7,7,7,8,8,8,7,7,4,8],[8,7,7,3,8,8,8,7,7,7,8,8,8,3,7,7,8],[8,8,8,8,3,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,3,8,8,8,8],[8,8,8,8,7,7,4,7,7,7,4,7,7,8,8,8,8],[8,8,8,8,7,4,4,7,1,7,4,4,7,8,8,8,8],[8,7,7,7,7,7,7,4,1,4,7,7,7,7,7,7,8],[8,1,7,7,7,7,1,1,7,1,1,7,7,7,7,1,8],[8,7,7,7,7,7,7,4,1,4,7,7,7,7,7,7,8],[8,8,8,8,7,4,4,7,1,7,4,4,7,8,8,8,8],[8,8,8,8,7,7,4,7,7,7,4,7,7,8,8,8,8],[8,8,8,8,3,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,3,8,8,8,8],[8,7,7,3,8,8,8,7,7,7,8,8,8,3,7,7,8],[8,4,7,7,8,8,8,7,7,7,8,8,8,7,7,4,8],[8,4,4,7,8,8,8,7,1,7,8,8,8,7,4,4,8],[8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8]]
```
